verses.ar: اَلصِّيتُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلدُّهْنِ ٱلطَّيِّبِ، وَيَوْمُ ٱلْمَمَاتِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ يَوْمِ ٱلْوِلَادَةِ.
verses.kjv: A good name [is] better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one’s birth.
verses.web: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

verses.ar: اَلذَّهَابُ إِلَى بَيْتِ ٱلنَّوْحِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَابِ إِلَى بَيْتِ ٱلْوَلِيمَةِ، لِأَنَّ ذَاكَ نِهَايَةُ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ، وَٱلْحَيُّ يَضَعُهُ فِي قَلْبِهِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ [It is] better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that [is] the end of all men; and the living will lay [it] to his heart.
verses.web: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

verses.ar: اَلْحُزْنُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلضَّحِكِ، لِأَنَّهُ بِكَآبَةِ ٱلْوَجْهِ يُصْلَحُ ٱلْقَلْبُ.
verses.kjv: Sorrow [is] better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
verses.web: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

verses.ar: قَلْبُ ٱلْحُكَمَاءِ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلنَّوْحِ، وَقَلْبُ ٱلْجُهَّالِ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلْفَرَحِ.
verses.kjv: The heart of the wise [is] in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools [is] in the house of mirth.
verses.web: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

verses.ar: سَمْعُ ٱلِٱنْتِهَارِ مِنَ ٱلْحَكِيمِ خَيْرٌ لِلْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ سَمْعِ غِنَاءِ ٱلْجُهَّالِ،
verses.kjv: [It is] better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.
verses.web: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ كَصَوْتِ ٱلشَّوْكِ تَحْتَ ٱلْقِدْرِ هَكَذَا ضَحِكُ ٱلْجُهَّالِ. هَذَا أَيْضًا بَاطِلٌ.
verses.kjv: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so [is] the laughter of the fool: this also [is] vanity.
verses.web: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلظُّلْمَ يُحَمِّقُ ٱلْحَكِيمَ، وَٱلْعَطِيَّةَ تُفْسِدُ ٱلْقَلْبَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.
verses.web: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

verses.ar: نِهَايَةُ أَمْرٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ بَدَايَتِهِ. طُولُ ٱلرُّوحِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ تَكَبُّرِ ٱلرُّوحِ.
verses.kjv: Better [is] the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: [and] the patient in spirit [is] better than the proud in spirit.
verses.web: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

verses.ar: لَا تُسْرِعْ بِرُوحِكَ إِلَى ٱلْغَضَبِ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْغَضَبَ يَسْتَقِرُّ فِي حِضْنِ ٱلْجُهَّالِ.
verses.kjv: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
verses.web: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

verses.ar: لَا تَقُلْ: «لِمَاذَا كَانَتِ ٱلْأَيَّامُ ٱلْأُولَى خَيْرًا مِنْ هَذِهِ؟» لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَنْ حِكْمَةٍ تَسْأَلُ عَنْ هَذَا.
verses.kjv: Say not thou, What is [the cause] that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.
verses.web: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

verses.ar: اَلْحِكْمَةُ صَالِحَةٌ مِثْلُ ٱلْمِيرَاثِ، بَلْ أَفْضَلُ لِنَاظِرِي ٱلشَّمْسِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Wisdom [is] good with an inheritance: and [by it there is] profit to them that see the sun.
verses.web: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِي فِي ظِلِّ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ هُوَ فِي ظِلِّ ٱلْفِضَّةِ، وَفَضْلُ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ هُوَ إِنَّ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ تُحْيِي أَصْحَابَهَا.
verses.kjv: For wisdom [is] a defence, [and] money [is] a defence: but the excellency of knowledge [is, that] wisdom giveth life to them that have it.
verses.web: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ عَمَلَ ٱللهِ: لِأَنَّهُ مَنْ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى تَقْوِيمِ مَا قَدْ عَوَّجَهُ؟
verses.kjv: Consider the work of God: for who can make [that] straight, which he hath made crooked?
verses.web: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

verses.ar: فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْخَيْرِ كُنْ بِخَيْرٍ، وَفِي يَوْمِ ٱلشَّرِّ ٱعْتَبِرْ. إِنَّ ٱللهَ جَعَلَ هَذَا مَعَ ذَاكَ، لِكَيْلَا يَجِدَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ شَيْئًا بَعْدَهُ.
verses.kjv: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.
verses.web: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

verses.ar: قَدْ رَأَيْتُ ٱلْكُلَّ فِي أَيَّامِ بُطْلِي: قَدْ يَكُونُ بَارٌّ يَبِيدُ فِي بِرِّهِ، وَقَدْ يَكُونُ شِرِّيرٌ يَطُولُ فِي شَرِّهِ.
verses.kjv: All [things] have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just [man] that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked [man] that prolongeth [his life] in his wickedness.
verses.web: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

verses.ar: لَا تَكُنْ بَارًّا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا تَكُنْ حَكِيمًا بِزِيَادَةٍ. لِمَاذَا تَخْرِبُ نَفْسَكَ؟
verses.kjv: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
verses.web: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

verses.ar: لَا تَكُنْ شِرِّيرًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا تَكُنْ جَاهِلًا. لِمَاذَا تَمُوتُ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِكَ؟
verses.kjv: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?
verses.web: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

verses.ar: حَسَنٌ أَنْ تَتَمَسَّكَ بِهَذَا، وَأَيْضًا أَنْ لَا تَرْخِيَ يَدَكَ عَنْ ذَاكَ، لِأَنَّ مُتَّقِيَ ٱللهِ يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا كِلَيْهِمَا.
verses.kjv: [It is] good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.
verses.web: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

verses.ar: اَلْحِكْمَةُ تُقَوِّي ٱلْحَكِيمَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ عَشَرَةِ مُسَلَّطِينَ، ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ.
verses.kjv: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty [men] which are in the city.
verses.web: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَا إِنْسَانٌ صِدِّيقٌ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ يَعْمَلُ صَلَاحًا وَلَا يُخْطِئُ.
verses.kjv: For [there is] not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.
verses.web: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا لَا تَضَعْ قَلْبَكَ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْكَلَامِ ٱلَّذِي يُقَالُ، لِئَلَّا تَسْمَعَ عَبْدَكَ يَسِبُّكَ.
verses.kjv: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:
verses.web: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ قَلْبَكَ أَيْضًا يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ كَذَلِكَ مِرَارًا كَثِيرَةً سَبَبْتَ آخَرِينَ.
verses.kjv: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.
verses.web: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

verses.ar: كُلُّ هَذَا ٱمْتَحَنْتُهُ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ. قُلْتُ: «أَكُونُ حَكِيمًا». أَمَّا هِيَ فَبَعِيدَةٌ عَنِّي.
verses.kjv: ¶ All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it [was] far from me.
verses.web: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

verses.ar: بَعِيدٌ مَا كَانَ بَعِيدًا، وَٱلْعَمِيقُ ٱلْعَمِيقُ مَنْ يَجِدُهُ؟
verses.kjv: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?
verses.web: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

verses.ar: دُرْتُ أَنَا وَقَلْبِي لِأَعْلَمَ وَلِأَبْحَثَ وَلِأَطْلُبَ حِكْمَةً وَعَقْلًا، وَلِأَعْرِفَ ٱلشَّرَّ أَنَّهُ جَهَالَةٌ، وَٱلْحَمَاقَةَ أَنَّهَا جُنُونٌ.
verses.kjv: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason [of things], and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness [and] madness:
verses.web: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

verses.ar: فَوَجَدْتُ أَمَرَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ: ٱلْمَرْأَةَ ٱلَّتِي هِيَ شِبَاكٌ، وَقَلْبُهَا أَشْرَاكٌ، وَيَدَاهَا قُيُودٌ. ٱلصَّالِحُ قُدَّامَ ٱللهِ يَنْجُو مِنْهَا. أَمَّا ٱلْخَاطِئُ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِهَا.
verses.kjv: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart [is] snares and nets, [and] her hands [as] bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.
verses.web: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ. هَذَا وَجَدْتُهُ، قَالَ ٱلْجَامِعَةُ: وَاحِدَةً فَوَاحِدَةً لِأَجِدَ ٱلنَّتِيجَةَ
verses.kjv: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, [counting] one by one, to find out the account:
verses.web: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي لَمْ تَزَلْ نَفْسِي تَطْلُبُهَا فَلَمْ أَجِدْهَا. رَجُلًا وَاحِدًا بَيْنَ أَلْفٍ وَجَدْتُ، أَمَّا ٱمْرَأَةً فَبَيْنَ كُلِّ أُولَئِكَ لَمْ أَجِدْ!
verses.kjv: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.
verses.web: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

verses.ar: اُنْظُرْ. هَذَا وَجَدْتُ فَقَطْ: أَنَّ ٱللهَ صَنَعَ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ مُسْتَقِيمًا، أَمَّا هُمْ فَطَلَبُوا ٱخْتِرَاعَاتٍ كَثِيرَةً.
verses.kjv: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
verses.web: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”
